journey.name: TL-14 A delete that fails keeps the row and offers no undo
journey.description:
The other half of TL-05. onDelete posts TaskDeleted only from its onSuccess branch, so a failed delete must produce a failure snackbar and nothing else - no "Task deleted", no Undo offer for a task that was never removed, and no row missing from the list.
The pairing that would be wrong is an optimistic removal. DefaultTaskRepository writes to the API first and touches the cache only once the call succeeds, and this is that rule rendered at the delete seam, where a user would notice it as a row that vanishes and comes back.
The failure snackbar is SnackbarDuration.Short - about four seconds - so start the dump within a second of the tap.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0 # wait for the four seed rows, then break the source adb shell am broadcast -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.qa.QaControlReceiver -a com.rounds.test.to_dolist.QA_SET_FAILURE_RATE --es qa_failure_rate 1.0

actions.action: Verify that "Book dentist" is on screen
Tap the element with the content description "Delete task" on the "Book dentist" row
Verify that "No connection. Check your network and try again." is on screen
Verify that no message reading "Task deleted" is on screen
Verify that no "Undo" action is on screen
Verify that "Book dentist" is still on screen
Verify that exactly four elements with the content description "Delete task" are on screen
Verify that "Retry" is not on screen
